title: Bounded finite-lisse etale model at one coefficient level
statement: Let X,Y,g,d,U,n,N,E,hbounded,hfinite,hmodels be as in lem-weil-pbc-lisse-finite-level-etale-descent. There exists an etale derived complex D over U.left at coefficient ring lisseTowerEtaleRing d n whose cohomology has the same bounded window and is finite locally constant in every degree, together with an isomorphism from its explicit lisseTowerFixedRealization to the pulled-back N. This subclaim omits the geometric Isom-stalk assertion.

source.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z and 09B1, bounded-below classical comparison; Tag 09BV, local Isom torsors.

proof.text: Let F be the explicit fixed-realization equivalence at (U.hom ≫ g,d,n), let P be the actual pullback of N, and define K = F.inverse(P). The finite scalar cohomology calculation gives boundedness of K and lisse proetale cohomology from the supplied bounded finite algebraic local models.

Apply finite-lisse proetale origin to each H^q(K), obtaining a finite locally constant etale sheaf G_q and ν^*G_q ≅ H^q(K). Apply the corrected bounded classical comparison to K and these cohomology models, giving an etale complex D, its bounds and finite-lisse cohomology, and e:ν^*D ≅ K.

Apply F to e and compose with the actual equivalence counit F(F.inverse(P)) ≅ P. This is the required comparison to the original pullback. The etale model is tied to that pullback rather than chosen independently.

proof_origin.place: Tags 099Y, 099Z and 09B1; construct the inverse-realization object first, then descend it by its classical cohomology and the canonical derived counit.

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_level_etale_model
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (U : Y.ProEt) (n : ℕ)
    (N : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))))
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)))
    (hbounded : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj E))
    (hfinite : ∀ q : ℤ, Module.Finite (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) q).obj E))
    (hmodels : ∃ T : Sieve U, T ∈ ProEt.topology Y U ∧
      ∀ (W : Y.ProEt) (w : W ⟶ U), T w →
        Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
          (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
            ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)) :
    ∃ D : DerivedCategory
        (Sheaf U.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n))),
      (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ q : ℤ, q < a ∨ b < q →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) ∧
      (∀ q : ℤ, IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj D)) ∧
      Nonempty ((lisseTowerFixedRealization (U.hom ≫ g) d n).obj
        ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (lisseTowerEtaleRing d n)) U.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj D) ≅
        (adicTowerPullback (U.hom ≫ g) ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj N)
